SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CL02.CSTMR_ID AS CSTMR_ID , CL02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AS DEAL_STTMN_NO , CL02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ AS DEAL_STTMN_SEQ FROM KEPMPGR02 GR02 , KEPMPSO06 SO06 , KEPMPSO04 SO04 , KEPMDCA16 CA16 , KEPMPCL02 CL02 WHERE 1 = 1 AND CA16.CNSTRCMP_CTGRY_CD IN (SELECT CNSTRCMP_CTGRY_CD FROM KEPMDCA15 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN( 'KRDOOP0011' , 'KRDOOP0012', 'KRDOOS0004C002', 'KRDOOS0012C002') AND HRANK_CNSTRCMP_CTGRY_CD='CTUA00000001') AND GR02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND GR02.ORDR_NO = SO06.ORDR_NO AND GR02.ORDR_SEQ = SO06.ORDR_SEQ AND SO06.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.ORDR_RE_NO = SO04.ORDR_RE_NO AND SO06.ORDR_RE_SEQ = SO04.ORDR_RE_SEQ AND SO04.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND GR02.CSTMR_ID = CA16.CSTMR_ID AND GR02.GDS_CD = CA16.GDS_CD AND CL02.CSTMR_ID IN( 'KRDOOP0011', 'KRDOOP0012', 'KRDOOS0004C002', 'KRDOOS0012C002') AND CL02.CLSN_YYMON = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, - 1), 'yyyymm') AND CL02.BIZ_CLSS_CD = 'C001' AND CL02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND CL02.SLS_CNFRM_CHK = 'Y' AND CL02.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_NO = GR02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ = GR02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ AND 1=2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT ROWNUM UNLST_ASST_NO , UNLST_ASST_CLS_CD , SIT_ASST_YN , '(select pjt_cd from tbco600 where SIT_DEPT_CD = ACQS_DEPT_CD)'ACQS_PJT_CD , ACQS_DEPT_CD , GNM , SPEC , SERIAL_NO , ACQS_DT , ACQS_UPRC , ACQS_VNDR_NM , MAKE_VNDR_NM , DUSE_DT , DUSE_RSN , DISPSL_DT , DISPSL_AMT , ATFL_ID , ELAP_ID , FST_REG_DTM , REGPSN_ID , FNL_UPD_DTM , UPDPSN_ID , QTY FROM (SELECT CNSTRCMP_CTGRY_CD UNLST_ASST_CLS_CD , NVL ( (SELECT CNSTRCMP_SITE_CHK FROM KEPMPSO03 A , KEPCODP01 B WHERE A.CSTMR_ID = B.ALANC_ID AND A.UNWRTR_DEPT_CD = B.ALANC_DEPT_CD AND ORDR_RE_NO = SO04.ORDR_RE_NO ), 'N' ) SIT_ASST_YN , NULL ACQS_PJT_CD , (SELECT UNWRTR_DEPT_CD FROM KEPMPSO03 A , KEPCODP01 B WHERE A.CSTMR_ID = B.ALANC_ID AND A.UNWRTR_DEPT_CD = B.ALANC_DEPT_CD AND ORDR_RE_NO = SO04.ORDR_RE_NO ) ACQS_DEPT_CD , SO04.GDS_NM GNM , SO04.STND_NM SPEC , NULL SERIAL_NO , GR02.STCKAG_DATE ACQS_DT , CL02.SLS_UNTPRC ACQS_UPRC , GETALANCINFO(GR02.SPPLR_ID, 'ALANC_NM') ACQS_VNDR_NM , GETMNFATREINFO(SO04.MNFATRE_CD, 'MNFATRE_NM')MAKE_VNDR_NM , NULL DUSE_DT , NULL DUSE_RSN , NULL DISPSL_DT , NULL DISPSL_AMT , NULL ATFL_ID , NULL ELAP_ID , SYSDATE FST_REG_DTM , SO04.RESGTR_ID REGPSN_ID , NULL FNL_UPD_DTM , NULL UPDPSN_ID , CL02.SLS_QTY QTY FROM KEPMPGR02 GR02 , KEPMPSO06 SO06 , KEPMPSO04 SO04 , KEPMDCA16 CA16 , KEPMPCL02 CL02 WHERE 1 = 1 AND GR02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND GR02.ORDR_NO = SO06.ORDR_NO AND GR02.ORDR_SEQ = SO06.ORDR_SEQ AND SO06.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.ORDR_RE_NO = SO04.ORDR_RE_NO AND SO06.ORDR_RE_SEQ = SO04.ORDR_RE_SEQ AND SO04.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND GR02.CSTMR_ID = CA16.CSTMR_ID AND GR02.GDS_CD = CA16.GDS_CD AND CL02.BIZ_CLSS_CD = 'C001' AND CL02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND CL02.SLS_CNFRM_CHK = 'Y' AND CL02.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_NO = GR02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ = GR02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ AND CL02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_NO = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_NO$' AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPCL02 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE 1=1 AND CL02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_NO = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_NO$' AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPCL02 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE 1=1 AND CL02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_NO = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_NO$' AND CL02.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ = '$G_RS.DEAL_STTMN_SEQ$'
